claim: Inflation indexation always produces a better CGT outcome than the 50% discount for long-held assets.
short_explanation: Inflation indexation does not guarantee a lower CGT liability. The 50% discount may be more favourable when inflation is high over the holding period, as indexation only adjusts the cost base upward, while the discount directly halves the total gain.
detailed_explanation: While CPI indexation raises the cost base to reflect inflation, it doesn't reduce the taxable gain itself—only the discount method cuts the gain in half. With high inflation over extended periods, the indexed cost base may still leave a substantial taxable gain, making the 50% discount more advantageous in many scenarios.
